title: Window Functions
summary: Window functions compute across rows related to the current row WITHOUT collapsing them: ROW_NUMBER, RANK, SUM() OVER (PARTITION BY ...).
learningObjectives: Apply the concept in a small program
Predict program output by reading code

sections.content: Window functions compute across rows related to the current row WITHOUT collapsing them: ROW_NUMBER, RANK, SUM() OVER (PARTITION BY ...).
Use for running totals, top-N per group, moving averages — things GROUP BY cannot express without losing row detail.
Key points: OVER() defines the window, PARTITION BY groups within it, ORDER BY inside OVER controls frame, and they are slower than plain aggregates.
